name: Drinking Alcohol
overview: Scripture acknowledges the provision of wine as a part of God's creation that can be enjoyed with a joyful heart, as seen in Ecclesiastes 9:7 and Psalms 104:14. However, the Bible also warns against the dangers of excessive drinking and intoxication, describing wine as a mocker and strong drink as raging, which can lead to sorrow, contention, and harm (Proverbs 20:1; 23:29). Furthermore, Leviticus 10:9 sets a solemn boundary by prohibiting priests and their sons from drinking wine when entering the tabernacle, underscoring the need for sobriety in sacred duties. Believers are therefore called to exercise wisdom and self-control, avoiding the company of those who indulge in riotous drinking (Proverbs 23:20).
